jobs.name: Berita AI Harian (Pagi)
jobs.prompt:
Tuan Hafizi mahu ringkasan berita AI TERKINI dihantar ke Telegram setiap pagi (waktu Malaysia). Jalankan tugasan ini sepenuhnya autonomi — jangan tanya soalan, jangan tunggu input. Output akhir anda ADALAH mesej yang dihantar (jangan guna send_message).

LANGKAH WAJIB:

1. skill_view(name='tech-news-digest') dan ikut workflow + pitfall di dalamnya.

2. Ground tarikh dulu (JANGAN agak dari ingatan):
   TZ=Asia/Kuala_Lumpur date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z'
   Window liputan = 24-48 jam terakhir sahaja.

3. Jalankan SEKURANG-KURANGNYA 4 web_search secara selari dalam satu round:
   - "AI news today <bulan> <hari> <tahun>"
   - "artificial intelligence announcement this week <bulan> <tahun>"
   - "open source AI model release <bulan> <tahun>"
   - "trending AI GitHub repositories <bulan> <tahun>"

4. LARANGAN KERAS — JANGAN guna web_extract walaupun sekali. Backend ddgs pada host ini memang rosak untuk extraction (gagal 100%). Untuk butiran penuh guna:
   (a) deep-search: 4-6 web_search bertarget pada tajuk berita (snippet + tarikh), dan
   (b) curl + script tempatan:
       curl -sL -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o /tmp/tc-home.html "https://techcrunch.com/"
       python3 /home/hafizi145/.hermes/skills/research/tech-news-digest/scripts/html-extract.py /tmp/tc-home.html
   Guna hanya URL yang datang dari hasil carian atau homepage — JANGAN reka slug/path URL, JANGAN reka nama repo atau bilangan star.

5. Fokus AI dahulu: model baru & benchmark, agent/agentic framework, open-weight release, AI infra/GPU/data center, polisi & regulasi AI, AI dalam bisnes/funding. Teknologi umum lain hanya kalau berkait AI.

6. Format laporan — BM casual + dialek Kelantan sedikit (sohor, goni, mung, kito, pacak megah) tapi jangan dipaksa. Scannable, bullet, ringkas (max ~450 patah perkataan):

# 🤖 Berita AI — <tarikh MYT>
## 🔥 Paling Panas
(3-5 item, mesti ada tarikh terbit dalam window 24-48 jam)
## 🤖 Open-Source & Model Baru
(3-4 item)
## ⭐ GitHub Naik Bukit

| Projek | Apa Dia | ⭐ |
|---|---|---|

## 📌 Apa Kito Patut Tahu
(2-4 bullet — kesan praktikal untuk HAFJET: OpenRouter/gateway, GPU lokal RTX, model Qwen/DeepSeek, agent Hermes)
## 📎 Sumber
(senarai bernombor + URL)

7. Kalau benar-benar TIADA berita AI baharu (semua item sudah dilaporkan dalam run sebelum ini), balas TEPAT: [SILENT]

8. Jangan guna execute_code (disekat dalam cron). Jangan guna python3 -c atau python3 << heredoc. Buat fail .py guna write_file kalau perlu.

jobs.name: hafjet-pickup-reminder
jobs.prompt:
Run the HAFJET pickup reminder (WhatsApp) job.

COMMAND — use this exact wrapper (it bridges WhatsApp creds from ~/.hermes/whatsapp-bot/.env and injects the known-good constants):
  /home/hafizi145/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python3 /home/hafizi145/.hermes/skills/software-development/hafjet-biz-ops/scripts/hafjet_pickup_runner.py

Steps:
1. Run the command above in the foreground (allow up to ~10 minutes). Do NOT run hafjet_pickup_reminder.py directly — GOOGLE_SHEET_ID / GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS / OWNER_PHONE are NOT in ~/.hermes/.env, so the raw script exits "Missing env".
2. What it does: reads Google Sheet tab "REPAIR BARU", filters Status == "SIAP" (NOT "SIAP DIAMBIL" — that value does not exist in the sheet), and sends a free-form WhatsApp reminder to each customer's NO TELEFON. It never messages the owner as a customer.
3. Cooldown dedupe (7 days) is ACTIVE — state at ~/.hermes/state/pickup_reminder_state.json. Rows reminded within the cooldown are SKIPPED, so a normal run now sends ~0-15 messages instead of ~600. This is CORRECT behaviour: do not "fix" it, do not delete the state file, and never run a catch-up blast.
4. WhatsApp error 470 (24h window) is logged and skipped — expected, no action needed.
5. An owner summary is sent automatically to 60198021500 by the script.

Report concisely: sent count, failed/skipped count, cooldown-skip count, any 470 blocks, plus a one-line flag if the log shows anything abnormal. Do NOT send any extra WhatsApp message yourself.

jobs.name: HAFJET Monthly Gaji-Profit Tracker
jobs.prompt:
Run the HAFJET monthly Gaji vs Profit tracker update.

Steps:
1. Loyverse token: run `grep LOYVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN ~/.hermes/.env | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- > /tmp/.loyverse_token` (the script also reads ~/.hermes/.env itself as a fallback).
2. Run the tracker script. PERMANENT PATH (jangan sesekali guna /tmp — skrip lama di /tmp sudah hilang):
   /home/hafizi145/.hermes/skills/devops/loyverse-sales/scripts/gaji_profit_calc.py
   Target month = PREVIOUS month (bukan bulan semasa). Kalau hari ini 1 haribulan, bulan laporan = bulan lepas (contoh: 1 Ogos -> Julai). Run:
   python3 /home/hafizi145/.hermes/skills/devops/loyverse-sales/scripts/gaji_profit_calc.py YYYY MM
   (kalau argumen tiada, skrip boleh auto-derive bulan lepas — tapi beri YYYY MM yang eksplisit supaya pasti).
3. Skrip auto-fetch jualan Loyverse untuk bulan itu, tolak kos tetap (Sewa RM400 + BSN RM400 + TNB RM500 = RM1,300), kira net profit, baki hidup, dan status hire-readiness, kemudian upsert baris ke ~/.hermes/reports/gaji_profit_tracker.csv.
4. Lepas skrip jalan, baca baris akhir output dan hantar ringkasan Telegram yang padat kepada Tuan Hafizi:
   - Bulan laporan
   - Jualan total
   - Net Profit
   - Kos Tetap (RM1,300)
   - Baki Hidup (selepas kos, sebelum gaji)
   - Status hire-readiness (READY / PART-TIME / BELUM + gap amount)
5. Ringkasan mesti pendek dan mudah dibaca (bullet points), dalam Bahasa Melayu. Nota: API Loyverse hanya pulangkan sejarah 31 hari, jadi run pada 1 haribulan menangkap bulan lepas dengan lengkap.

Penting: kalau skrip tiada, skrip gagal, atau angka tak keluar — laporkan BLOCKED dengan jujur dan sebab sebenar. Jangan reka nombor.

Generate and deliver the HAFJET monthly Profit & Loss report using pnl_generator_v2.py.

1. Run: python3 /home/hafizi145/.hermes/skills/pnl_generator_v2.py (auto-detects the PREVIOUS month)

   - Period (Month Year)
   - Revenue, COGS, Gross Profit, Gross Margin %
